name: [🧩NEL ISAGI] META LOCK
desc:
Blue Lock inspired game.
Build your own striker, master powerful football styles, and outplay rivals in intense matches. Customize your playstyle, unlock unique skills, and awaken your true potential to become the world's #1 striker.

[PC, MOBILE AND CONSOLE]

[CONTROLS]
LEFT CLICK: Dribble
RIGHT CLICK: Shoot
CTRL: SHIFT LOCK
SHIFT: SPRINT
F: Tackle
E: Trap
G: Flow
R: Talent
C: Pass Call

Don't forget to like the game for more updates ! Enjoy !
